info.title: Sybeez Finance API
info.description: School-scoped fees and finance portal contracts. Money values are decimal strings. Every finance row is scoped to the caller school. Fee-desk routes the web app calls live under /api/v1/fees. Send X-Branch-Id to limit a call to one branch.

get.description: Schools and roles this user can sign into, including accountant, cashier, and auditor.

schema.title: Response List Memberships Api V1 Auth Memberships Get

post.description: Issue a new access token for another school membership. Role is stamped on the token.

get.description:
Branches of the caller's school. Cashiers see only assigned branches.

Send the chosen branch on later fee calls as the X-Branch-Id header.
